archetypes.title: Thin the Ranks
archetypes.summary: Cull enough of the family's rank-and-file that their boss's own den will crack open — nobody guards a boss they can't afford to lose.

archetypes.title: Steal the Ledger
archetypes.summary: Lift the family's book of favors from a spawned drop in their territory. Without it their den's outer wards go dark and the door falls open.

archetypes.title: Win Their Favor
archetypes.summary: Play nice — get to Friendly (>75) with the family and they'll invite you inside themselves. The peaceful path to the den.

archetypes.title: Sabotage the Still
archetypes.summary: Wreck the family's refinery set-piece in their territory. Their boss won't dare leave the safe of the den until the racket downstairs is fixed — but the door's guards do.

archetypes.title: Bring Tribute
archetypes.summary: Deliver units of the contested resource to the den door and the family opens up — you're 'family' now, at least for the length of one bribe.

archetypes.title: The Rival's Hit
archetypes.summary: A rival family will crack this den open for you if you take out one of their competitor's key mobs first. Contract killing, mob-drama style.
